name: prometeo
description: Prometeo — Scientific Intelligence for Fire Safety in Space (NASA Space Apps 2026: Flame in Freefall)

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/backend && uv run prometeo serve
scripts.check:api: cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy && uv run lint-imports && uv run pytest
scripts.contracts: cd apps/backend && uv run prometeo export-openapi && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @prometeo/contracts generate
scripts.check: pnpm check:api && pnpm lint:web && pnpm typecheck:web
